types.name: polychart.v1.CreateLayerShareLinkRequest
types.doc: CreateLayerShareLinkRequest creates a token-gated share link for a layer.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: Layer to share.

fields.name: perms
fields.doc: Permission bitmask for the share link: VIEW=1, EDIT=2, SHARE=4, MANAGE=8.

fields.name: expires_at_ms
fields.doc: Expiration time in milliseconds since epoch (UTC); 0 means the link does not expire.

types.name: polychart.v1.CreateLayerShareLinkResponse
types.doc: CreateLayerShareLinkResponse returns the minted share token.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: Opaque share token.

types.name: polychart.v1.DeleteDrawingRequest
types.doc: DeleteDrawingRequest soft-deletes one drawing using the parent layer revision.

fields.name: drawing
fields.doc: Drawing to delete.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: Parent layer that contains the drawing.

fields.name: expected_layer_revision
fields.doc: Expected current revision of the parent layer.

types.name: polychart.v1.DeleteDrawingResponse
types.doc: DeleteDrawingResponse returns the new parent layer revision.

fields.name: layer_revision
fields.doc: New parent layer revision after deletion.

types.name: polychart.v1.DeleteLayerRequest
types.doc: DeleteLayerRequest soft-deletes a layer and its drawings using optimistic concurrency.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: Layer to delete.

fields.name: expected_revision
fields.doc: Expected current layer revision.

types.name: polychart.v1.DeleteLayerResponse
types.doc: DeleteLayerResponse returns the final layer revision after deletion.

fields.name: layer_revision
fields.doc: Final layer revision after delete.

types.name: polychart.v1.Drawing
types.doc: Drawing is a shape or annotation stored inside a layer.

fields.name: owner_id
fields.doc: Account that owns the drawing.

fields.name: drawing_id
fields.doc: Drawing identifier unique within the owner account.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: Parent layer for the drawing.

fields.name: engine_symbol_id
fields.doc: Engine symbol identifier for the drawing market.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: Client-defined drawing type identifier.

fields.name: version
fields.doc: Client-defined payload schema version.

fields.name: payload
fields.doc: Serialized drawing payload bytes.

fields.name: bbox_time_min_ms
fields.doc: Minimum drawing time bound in milliseconds since epoch (UTC); 0 means unset.

fields.name: bbox_time_max_ms
fields.doc: Maximum drawing time bound in milliseconds since epoch (UTC); 0 means unset.

fields.name: bbox_price_min
fields.doc: Minimum drawing price bound; 0 means unset.

fields.name: bbox_price_max
fields.doc: Maximum drawing price bound; 0 means unset.

fields.name: updated_at_ms
fields.doc: Server-assigned commit timestamp in milliseconds since epoch (UTC).

fields.name: deleted_at_ms
fields.doc: Server-assigned deletion timestamp in milliseconds since epoch (UTC); 0 means not deleted.

fields.name: client_updated_at_ms
fields.doc: Client-assigned commit timestamp in milliseconds since epoch (UTC), used for last-write-wins merge.

types.name: polychart.v1.DrawingRef
types.doc: DrawingRef uniquely identifies a drawing across owners.

fields.name: owner_id
fields.doc: Account that owns the drawing.

fields.name: drawing_id
fields.doc: Drawing identifier unique within the owner account.

types.name: polychart.v1.GetLayerSnapshotRequest
types.doc: Fetch a single layer snapshot for realtime gap recovery and share viewing.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: Layer to fetch.

types.name: polychart.v1.GetLayerSnapshotResponse
types.doc: GetLayerSnapshotResponse returns a layer and all non-deleted drawings in it.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: Current layer metadata.

fields.name: drawings
fields.doc: Drawings currently in the layer.

types.name: polychart.v1.GetLayerSubscribeTokensRequest
types.doc: Authenticated viewers request realtime subscribe tokens for layer channels.

fields.name: layers
fields.doc: Layers for which the caller needs subscribe tokens.

types.name: polychart.v1.GetLayerSubscribeTokensResponse
types.doc: GetLayerSubscribeTokensResponse contains subscribe tokens for authorized layers.

fields.name: tokens
fields.doc: Subscribe tokens keyed by layer.

types.name: polychart.v1.GetMarketLayersRequest
types.doc: Load viewer's subscribed layers + drawings for a market.

fields.name: engine_symbol_id
fields.doc: Engine symbol identifier for the market to load.

types.name: polychart.v1.GetMarketLayersResponse
types.doc: GetMarketLayersResponse returns subscribed layer metadata and enabled drawing snapshots.

fields.name: engine_symbol_id
fields.doc: Engine symbol identifier for the returned market.

fields.name: subscriptions
fields.doc: Caller subscriptions for the market.

fields.name: layers
fields.doc: Only layers referenced by `subscriptions` are returned here.

fields.name: drawings
fields.doc: Drawings are returned only for enabled subscriptions (avoid huge payloads).

types.name: polychart.v1.Layer
types.doc: Layer is a shareable container of drawings for one market.

fields.name: owner_id
fields.doc: Account that owns the layer.

fields.name: layer_id
fields.doc: Layer identifier unique within the owner account.

fields.name: engine_symbol_id
fields.doc: Engine symbol identifier for the market this layer belongs to.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Human-readable layer name.

fields.name: sort_hint
fields.doc: Owner-defined ordering hint for the layer list.

fields.name: color_rgba
fields.doc:
Owner-level style defaults.
 Packed layer color in 0xAARRGGBB format.

fields.name: use_layer_color
fields.doc: True when drawings should use the layer color by default.

fields.name: is_locked
fields.doc: True when clients should prevent editing drawings in this layer.

fields.name: is_visible
fields.doc: True when the layer is visible by default.

fields.name: revision
fields.doc: Monotonic per layer; increments on any committed change to the layer or its drawings.

fields.name: updated_at_ms
fields.doc: Server-assigned commit timestamp in milliseconds since epoch (UTC).

types.name: polychart.v1.LayerRef
types.doc: LayerRef uniquely identifies a drawing layer across owners.

fields.name: owner_id
fields.doc: Account that owns the layer.

fields.name: layer_id
fields.doc: Layer identifier unique within the owner account.

types.name: polychart.v1.LayerSubscribeToken
types.doc: LayerSubscribeToken contains a subscribe token for one layer.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: Layer the token authorizes.

fields.name: centrifugo_sub_token
fields.doc: Short-lived realtime subscribe token for the layer.

types.name: polychart.v1.LayerSubscription
types.doc: LayerSubscription is the viewer's per-market preference for one accessible layer.

fields.name: viewer_id
fields.doc: Viewer account that owns this subscription.

fields.name: engine_symbol_id
fields.doc: Engine symbol identifier for the subscription market.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: Layer included in the viewer's market subscriptions.

fields.name: alias_name
fields.doc: Optional viewer-specific display name for the layer.

fields.name: sort_order
fields.doc: Viewer-defined ordering value for subscribed layers.

fields.name: is_enabled
fields.doc: True when drawings from this layer should be loaded by default.

fields.name: is_pinned
fields.doc: True when the layer should stay pinned in the viewer's layer list.

fields.name: is_visible_override
fields.doc:
Viewer overrides (optional).
 Visibility override for this viewer; unset means use the layer default.

fields.name: is_locked_override
fields.doc: Locked-state override for this viewer; unset means use the layer default.

types.name: polychart.v1.ListInboxMarketLayersRequest
types.doc:
List layers explicitly shared to the viewer for a market (metadata only; no drawings).
 This is the viewer's "inbox" for FOLLOWERS/GROUP/USER shares.
 It must NOT act as a global directory of PUBLIC layers.

fields.name: engine_symbol_id
fields.doc: Engine symbol identifier for the market inbox.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Maximum number of layers to return; the service may apply a smaller default or maximum.

fields.name: after_owner_id
fields.doc: Exclusive owner cursor from the previous response; 0 starts from the first page.

fields.name: after_layer_id
fields.doc: Exclusive layer cursor from the previous response; 0 starts from the first page.

types.name: polychart.v1.ListInboxMarketLayersResponse
types.doc: ListInboxMarketLayersResponse returns metadata-only shared layers for one market.

fields.name: engine_symbol_id
fields.doc: Engine symbol identifier for the returned market.

fields.name: layers
fields.doc: Shared layer metadata only; drawings are not included.

fields.name: next_after_owner_id
fields.doc: Cursor owner ID for the next page; 0 means there are no more pages.

fields.name: next_after_layer_id
fields.doc: Cursor layer ID for the next page; 0 means there are no more pages.

types.name: polychart.v1.ListOwnerPublishedLayersRequest
types.doc: ListOwnerPublishedLayersRequest lists discoverable layers for one owner.

fields.name: owner_id
fields.doc: Owner account whose published layers should be listed.

fields.name: engine_symbol_id
fields.doc: Optional market filter.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Maximum number of layers to return; the service may apply a smaller default or maximum.

fields.name: after_published_at_ms
fields.doc: Exclusive publication-time cursor from the previous response; 0 starts from the first page.

fields.name: after_layer_id
fields.doc: Exclusive layer cursor from the previous response; 0 starts from the first page.

types.name: polychart.v1.ListOwnerPublishedLayersResponse
types.doc: ListOwnerPublishedLayersResponse contains one page of discoverable layers.

fields.name: layers
fields.doc: Published layers, returned newest-published first.

fields.name: next_after_published_at_ms
fields.doc: Cursor publication timestamp for the next page; 0 means there are no more pages.

fields.name: next_after_layer_id
fields.doc: Cursor layer ID for the next page; 0 means there are no more pages.

types.name: polychart.v1.PublishLayerRequest
types.doc: PublishLayerRequest lists a layer for discovery. Publishing implies PUBLIC view access.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: Layer to publish.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: Public display title.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Public description shown with the layer.

fields.name: tags
fields.doc: Public tags used for grouping or filtering.

types.name: polychart.v1.PublishLayerResponse
types.doc: PublishLayerResponse returns the published layer metadata.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: Published layer metadata.

types.name: polychart.v1.PublishedLayer
types.doc: PublishedLayer contains discovery metadata for a listed layer.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: Listed layer metadata.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: Public display title.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Public description shown with the layer.

fields.name: tags
fields.doc: Public tags used for grouping or filtering.

fields.name: published_at_ms
fields.doc: Publication time in milliseconds since epoch (UTC).

types.name: polychart.v1.ResolveLayerShareTokenRequest
types.doc:
Resolve a share token to a layer snapshot. No auth required.
 This is the ONLY unauthenticated API for layers.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: Opaque share token from a layer share link.

types.name: polychart.v1.ResolveLayerShareTokenResponse
types.doc: ResolveLayerShareTokenResponse returns a view-only layer snapshot for a valid share token.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: Shared layer metadata.

fields.name: drawings
fields.doc: Drawings currently in the shared layer.

fields.name: centrifugo_sub_token
fields.doc: Optional short-lived realtime subscribe token scoped to this layer.

types.name: polychart.v1.RevokeLayerShareLinkRequest
types.doc: RevokeLayerShareLinkRequest revokes one previously minted layer share token.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: Opaque share token to revoke.

types.name: polychart.v1.RevokeLayerShareLinkResponse
types.doc: RevokeLayerShareLinkResponse is empty when the token was revoked.

types.name: polychart.v1.SetLayerSubscriptionsRequest
types.doc: SetLayerSubscriptionsRequest replaces the caller's layer subscriptions for one market.

fields.name: engine_symbol_id
fields.doc: Engine symbol identifier for the market whose subscriptions should be replaced.

fields.name: subscriptions
fields.doc:
Full replace for (viewer_id, engine_symbol_id).
 Server replaces all existing rows for the market with this list.

types.name: polychart.v1.SetLayerSubscriptionsResponse
types.doc: SetLayerSubscriptionsResponse is empty when subscriptions were saved.

types.name: polychart.v1.UnpublishLayerRequest
types.doc: UnpublishLayerRequest removes a layer from discovery listings.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: Layer to remove from discovery.

types.name: polychart.v1.UnpublishLayerResponse
types.doc: UnpublishLayerResponse is empty when the layer was removed from discovery.

types.name: polychart.v1.UpsertDrawingRequest
types.doc: UpsertDrawingRequest creates or updates one drawing using the parent layer revision.

fields.name: drawing
fields.doc: Drawing payload to create or update.

fields.name: expected_layer_revision
fields.doc: Expected current revision of the parent layer.

types.name: polychart.v1.UpsertDrawingResponse
types.doc: UpsertDrawingResponse returns the committed drawing and new parent layer revision.

fields.name: drawing
fields.doc: Drawing after server-side commit handling.

fields.name: layer_revision
fields.doc: New parent layer revision after mutation.

types.name: polychart.v1.UpsertLayerRequest
types.doc: UpsertLayerRequest creates or updates a layer using optimistic concurrency.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: Layer payload to create or update.

fields.name: expected_revision
fields.doc: Expected current layer revision; 0 creates a new layer.

types.name: polychart.v1.UpsertLayerResponse
types.doc: UpsertLayerResponse returns the committed layer.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: Layer after server-side commit handling.
